name: Microgrid black-start source selector
aliases: microgrids Microgrid black-start and restoration controls
summary: Selects an available resource declared capable of establishing the initial electrical reference.
description: Selects an available resource declared capable of establishing the initial electrical reference. Black-start and restoration control coordinates the establishment of an electrical reference and the gradual return of assigned resources and loads. A dead system, an available starting source and a successful load restoration are distinct states.

In a microgrid recovering from a blackout, an available grid-forming source can establish the assigned island reference before compatible generation and eligible load groups are introduced under the validated restoration strategy. For this reference, the drawing identifies “Black-start resource capability” at the input and “Selected starting source” at the output. Resource capability must be confirmed by its documentation.
